In the contact crop [447,1149,1065,1399] a raised ridge runs within ~40 px of the bottle foot at right, competing with the silhouette instead of receding as matte grain. Depth fade toward the horizon exists now, but foreground scale remains wrong.

The column head still collides with the horizon seam: the horizon sits at ~y455-465 while the logo bbox is [70,500,175,522], so 'Hermès' reads directly on the seam line and visually merges with it. Below, title bbox [70,560,457,723] leaves only a 38 px gap under the logo, then the rust rule at y782 leaves a 59 px gap: the logo-title-rule rhythm (38/59) is uneven and the block never closes optically.
